title: 第19章 未来的计划第20章 紫阳秘境
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: 眼睛一闭一睁，感受到身边灵气浓度骤降，陈昭便知道，自己已经返回了在玄清界落脚的山洞。
起身检查了一下，见布置在山洞中的防御阵法未有触动，陈昭这才放下心来，吞下一节灵气药材，快速炼化，回复起因为使用身法而见底的灵气来。
陈昭手上并非没有炼制好的回气丹，只是这些从他人储物袋中获得的丹药现在是用一个少一个，是陈昭库存里的稀罕货，即便这些回气丹的品质并不高，蕴含的灵气储量甚至不如被陈昭吞服下的这些灵气药材，可其能够快速炼化迅速补气的效果是有战略价值的。
总不能和人斗法到一半，说什么“道友停停，待我炼化一下药材，补充完灵气再斗法。”
不过，回气丹的快速回气效果也是有上限的，并非狂吃回气丹就能做到在斗法时无限灵气，在一定时间内，修士身体对这类丹药灵力的吸收率是有限的，服用过多，回气效果只会越来越差。
当然，回气丹的品质越高，回气效率也越高，因此一些能炼制高品质丹药的炼丹师会非常受欢迎，在宗门中的地位往往比同阶的修士要更加高，
炼化药材将灵力补充个七七八八，陈昭也不再那么焦急，转而掏出数枚下品灵石，在地上布置出个聚灵阵，开始吸纳起玄清界的灵气。
灵气大药可以炼制成各类丹药，就这么单纯吸收灵气太浪费了，该省省该花花，还是多吸纳玄清界的灵气吧。
可惜玄清界灵气的浓度注定要让陈昭失望了，已经习惯秘境之中浓郁灵气的陈昭面对这即便是用了聚灵阵也是寡淡如水的灵气，即便费尽心思去吸纳，效率也十分低下。
在秘境之中有巨量灵气时还好，到了玄清界这稀薄灵气之中后，原本灵气没有摘除的副作用便十分明显了，虽然新装上的上品火灵根吸纳灵气的效率非常高，但奈何老的杂灵根和新灵根争夺灵气，实际吸纳进去的量太少了。
陈昭叹了口气，还好在秘境之中时便已经将修为扩展到炼气圆满了，现在仅是回复灵气而已，若自己没有秘境，恐怕会被迫回到那魔教金丹身旁吧，到时候摘除原本灵根的同时，必定还会为自己植入监视的手段。
只是如今秘境之中有金丹大能在搜索自己，短时间内是别想回去了，既然要在这玄清界待上一段时间，那便好好计划一下吧。
做计划的时候陈昭也没闲着，拿出一口大锅来，按照体修手册上的标注将阳性药材用灵气震碎放入锅中熬煮，待药力激发之时，陈昭便坐入锅中，将身子浸入药液，吸收起药力来。
这大锅本是那炼金术师制药的锅，看起来是适配那炼金术师身材个头大小所打造的，陈昭坐进去其实有些偏小了，看来下回有空要去寻工匠打制一个更大的锅了。
感受着全身上下不断传来的火辣感，陈昭开始规划起在玄清界的行动。
首要目标，自然是获得筑基用的中品灵石，售卖药材这个方法，早在最开始就被排除了，至于在秘境之中获得灵石？陈昭想起了在地道之中见过的，镶嵌在地道天花板上用来照明的石头，从其中能感受到淡淡的灵力，虽然远不及最次的下品灵石，但至少证明这秘境之中也是有类似灵石产物的。
等过些时日，待那金丹强者离去后，再进入秘境之中探索吧，若是那叫芙兰卡的炼金术师还未身死，便从她那个方向入手调查吧。
话虽如此，陈昭却是持悲观态度的，恐怕再回秘境时，那位炼金术师已经一岁多了吧。
当时并非见死不救，只是以陈昭炼气期的修为，若是带上人一起跑，那注定是会被金丹大修追上灭杀的。
倒也不会为这事过于烦恼，毕竟一开始救人便已是仁，俗话说穷则独善其身，达则兼济天下，陈昭已经做到了能力范围内的最好，便是问心无愧了。
比起在秘境之中寻找灵石，陈昭反而是对玄清界更有思路。
玄清界的灵石产出自然不是凭空生成的，各地都有灵石矿脉，天门宗自然也是有着自己的灵石产业，役使那些杂役弟子进入开采。
灵石开采产业是没有凡人的，毕竟凡人无法感应到灵石中散发出的灵气。
据说以前天门宗也役使那些在宗门冲突中俘获的其他宗门修士进入开采，可这些修士往往会利用开采获得的灵石恢复自身，从而反抗天门宗，所以后来天门宗在宗门冲突中往往选择直接屠戮光敌对宗门的所有修士，仅仅保留一些修行能力差劲的杂役弟子来。
这些杂役弟子一旦修炼天门宗提供的逆练版天门功，即便偷偷拿开采所得的灵石修炼，也没有足够的灵气来对抗天门宗。
陈昭本也要被发配去灵矿脉挥舞锄头，因为手巧被炼器工坊的坊主要走，在炼器工坊中打杂一年，正巧躲过了那一批的灵矿差役。
与陈昭同期的杂役弟子前去挖灵石的，能够活着回来的十不存一。
根据幸存的杂役弟子描述，在那灵矿中工作时，每个杂役弟子都要脱掉衣服，仅保留最基础的亵衣，每天出矿的时候还要搜身，检查有无夹带。
每个杂役弟子每天必须挖掘到五块下品灵石，没有达到份额的就会遭到毒打，并且没有饭吃。
为了确保监视杂役弟子挖矿的这些正式弟子不偷偷自己取灵石来用，所有开采出来的灵石都要放入一个临时的仓库之中，这个仓库是只进不出的单向仓库，每隔一段时间，便会有筑基长老前来打开仓库查收，提取灵石转移到宗门主仓之中。
若是能获得这仓库中的灵石，起码能解决陈昭一半以上的灵石需求。
不过这仓库恐怕没那么好破坏吧，毕竟要防备那些炼气期的正式弟子偷窃，姑且认定他是筑基期才能打开的吧。
所以从一开始，陈昭便没有考虑破坏仓库这件事情。
但灵矿脉依旧是一个不错的选择，对于那些被押送进灵矿脉中劳役的杂役弟子们来说，挖矿是个苦活儿，但若是陈昭有机会能混进去，那便纯纯的福地了。

content_en:
As soon as he closed and opened his eyes and felt the concentration of spiritual energy around him drop sharply, Chen Zhao knew that he had returned to the cave where he settled in the Xuanqing Realm.
He stood up and checked, and saw that the defensive formations arranged in the cave had not been touched. Chen Zhao felt relieved, swallowed a section of spiritual energy medicinal materials, and quickly refined it to restore the spiritual energy that had bottomed out due to the use of body techniques.
It’s not that Chen Zhao doesn’t have refined Qi Rejuvenation Pills, but the pills he obtained from other people’s storage bags are now used one less, and they are rare items in Chen Zhao’s inventory. Even though the quality of these Qi Rejuvenation Pills is not high, and the amount of spiritual energy they contain is not even as good as the spiritual energy medicinal materials swallowed by Chen Zhao, their ability to quickly refine and quickly replenish energy is of strategic value.
You can't say something like "Friend Taoist, stop, wait until I refine the medicinal materials and replenish my spiritual energy before fighting with others."
However, there is an upper limit to the quick regeneration effect of the rejuvenation pills. It does not mean that if you consume the rejuvenation pills, you can have unlimited spiritual energy during the battle. Within a certain period of time, the monk's body's absorption rate of the spiritual power of this type of elixir is limited. If you take too much, the rejuvenation effect will only become worse and worse.
Of course, the higher the quality of the Qi Restoration Pill, the higher the Qi Restoration Efficiency. Therefore, some alchemists who can refine high-quality pills will be very popular, and their status in the sect is often higher than that of monks of the same level.
After refining the medicinal materials to replenish his spiritual power, Chen Zhao was no longer so anxious. Instead, he took out several low-grade spiritual stones, set up a spirit gathering array on the ground, and began to absorb the spiritual energy of the Xuanqing Realm.
Spiritual energy elixirs can be refined into various types of elixirs. Simply absorbing spiritual energy like this is too wasteful. You should save more time and energy and absorb more spiritual energy from the Xuanqing world.
It's a pity that the concentration of the spiritual energy in the Xuanqing Realm is destined to disappoint Chen Zhao. Chen Zhao, who is used to the rich spiritual energy in the secret realm, faces this spiritual energy that is as light as water even if he uses the spirit gathering array. Even if he tries his best to absorb it, the efficiency is very low.
It was okay when there was a huge amount of spiritual energy in the secret realm, but after arriving in the thin spiritual energy of the Xuanqing Realm, the side effects of not removing the original spiritual energy became very obvious. Although the newly installed high-grade fire spiritual roots were very efficient in absorbing spiritual energy, the old miscellaneous spiritual roots and the new spiritual roots competed for the spiritual energy, and the actual amount absorbed was too little.
"Alas"
Chen Zhao sighed. Fortunately, he had already expanded his cultivation to perfect Qi refining when he was in the secret realm. Now he is just restoring his spiritual energy. If he didn't have the secret realm, he would probably be forced to return to the demon sect's golden elixir. When the time comes, when the original spiritual root is removed, he will definitely be implanted with surveillance methods.
It's just that there is a powerful golden elixir searching for him in the secret realm. Don't think about going back in a short time. Since you have to stay in this Xuanqing world for a while, let's make a good plan.
Chen Zhao was not idle when he was making plans. He took out a large pot, crushed the positive medicinal materials with spiritual energy and boiled them in the pot according to the instructions in the physical training manual. When the medicinal power was activated, Chen Zhao sat in the pot, immersed his body in the medicinal liquid, and absorbed the medicinal power.
This cauldron was originally used by the alchemist to make medicine. It seemed to be made to fit the size of the alchemist's body. It was actually a little too small for Chen Zhao to sit in. It seemed that he would have to find a craftsman to make a larger cauldron next time he had time.
Feeling the burning sensation throughout his body, Chen Zhao began to plan his actions in the Xuanqing Realm.
The primary goal is naturally to obtain medium-grade spiritual stones for foundation building. The method of selling medicinal materials has been ruled out from the beginning. As for obtaining spiritual stones in the secret realm? Chen Zhao thought of the stones he had seen in the tunnel, which were inlaid on the ceiling of the tunnel for lighting. He could feel a faint spiritual power from them. Although it was far less than the lowest-grade spiritual stones, it at least proved that there were similar spiritual stone products in this secret realm.
Wait for some time, after the golden elixir powerhouse leaves, and then enter the secret realm to explore. If the alchemist named Franka is not dead yet, then start investigating from her direction.
Having said that, Chen Zhao is pessimistic. I am afraid that when he returns to the secret realm, the alchemist will be more than a year old.
At that time, it was not that he was desperate, but with Chen Zhao's cultivation during his Qi refining period, if he took someone with him and ran away, he was destined to be caught up and killed by the Jindan Daxiu.
I wouldn't worry too much about this matter. After all, it is benevolent to save people from the beginning. As the saying goes, if you are poor, you will be good for yourself, and if you are rich, you will help the world. Chen Zhao has done the best within his ability, and he has a clear conscience.
Rather than searching for spiritual stones in the secret realm, Chen Zhao has more ideas about the Xuanqing world.
The output of spirit stones in the Xuanqing Realm is naturally not generated out of thin air. There are spirit stone veins everywhere. The Tianmen Sect naturally has its own spirit stone industry and uses the handyman disciples to mine it.
There is no mortal in the spirit stone mining industry. After all, mortals cannot sense the spiritual energy emanating from the spirit stones.
It is said that in the past, Tianmen Sect also used monks from other sects captured in sect conflicts to engage in mining. However, these monks often used the spiritual stones obtained from mining to restore themselves and resisted Tianmen Sect. Therefore, later on, Tianmen Sect often chose to directly slaughter all monks from rival sects during sect conflicts, leaving only some handyman disciples with poor cultivation abilities.
Once these handyman disciples practice the reverse version of Tianmen Gong provided by Tianmen Sect, even if they secretly practice with the mined spiritual stones, they will not have enough spiritual energy to fight against Tianmen Sect.
Chen Zhaoben was also assigned to wield a hoe in the spirit mine veins. Because of his skill, he was hired by the boss of the refinery workshop. He worked in the refinery workshop for a year and happened to avoid that batch of spirit mine servants.
Of the handyman disciples who were at the same time as Chen Zhao who went to dig for spiritual stones, not even one out of ten came back alive.
According to the description of the surviving handyman disciples, when working in the Ling Mine, every handyman disciple had to take off his clothes, leaving only the most basic underwear. When leaving the mine every day, he had to be searched to check whether there was any entrainment.
Each handyman disciple must dig five pieces of low-grade spiritual stones every day. Those who do not reach the quota will be beaten severely and will not have food to eat.
In order to ensure that the formal disciples who monitor the handyman disciples' mining do not secretly take the spirit stones for use, all the mined spirit stones must be put into a temporary warehouse. This warehouse is a one-way warehouse that can only be entered and exited. Every once in a while, a foundation-building elder will come to open the warehouse for inspection, extract the spirit stones and transfer them to the sect's main warehouse.
If the spirit stones in this warehouse can be obtained, at least half of Chen Zhao's spiritual stone needs can be met.
But I'm afraid this warehouse is not that easy to destroy. After all, we have to guard against theft by those formal disciples in the Qi Refining Stage. Let's assume that he can only open it in the Foundation Establishment Stage.
So from the beginning, Chen Zhao did not consider destroying the warehouse.
But the spirit mineral vein is still a good choice. For the handyman disciples who are escorted to work in the spirit mineral vein, mining is a hard job, but if Chen Zhao has a chance to get in, it will be a pure blessing.
